description: Ministry of Lands & Parliament Reforms - Appoint Mr. H. P. C. D. Rathnayake as acquiring officers
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically concerns the appointment of an Acquiring Officer under the Land Acquisition Act for land acquisitions related to the construction of Basnagoda Reservoir. The core subject matter is land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While a person is named and appointed, the primary purpose and content of the notice are not about the government's structure or personnel changes, but about enabling a specific land-related administrative action.
